local sources = {}
sources['Library'] = [====[
--[[
	Owner Sigma Hub — UI layer
	====================================================================
	Совместимая обёртка: Obsidian-подобное API поверх TheWorstUI.
	Вся логика хаба (Main) остаётся без изменений — меняется только Gui.
	====================================================================
]]

local requireModule = ...
local TheWorstUI = requireModule("TheWorstUI")

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer      = Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService      = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui          = (typeof(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function safe(fn, ...)
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
	local pack = { pcall(fn, ...) }
	if not pack[1] then
		warn("[OSH-UI] " .. tostring(pack[2]))
		return
	end
	return select(2, unpack(pack))
end

local function strip(value)
	return (tostring(value or ""):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""))
end

local noop = function() end

local Library = {
	Options = {}, Toggles = {}, Tabs = {}, Labels = {},
	Connections = {}, UnloadCallbacks = {}, Elements = {}, DepBoxes = {},
	CornerRadius = 6,
	ForceCheckbox = false,
	ShowCustomCursor = false,
	Unloaded = false,
	ToggleKeybind = nil,
	ScreenGui = nil,
	KeybindFrame = nil,
	NotifySide = "Right",
}

Library.IsMobile = (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled) or false

-- любой неизвестный метод (SetXxx/Display/Update...) — безопасная заглушка
local ElementMT = {
	__index = function(_, key)
		if type(key) == "string" and key:match("^%u") then return noop end
		return nil
	end,
}

local function newElement(kind, idx, container)
	local E = setmetatable({
		Type = kind,
		Idx = idx,
		Container = container,
		Value = nil,
		_Visible = true,
		_Disabled = false,
		_DepHidden = false,
		_OnChanged = {},
		Rendered = false,
		Destroyed = false,
	}, ElementMT)
	table.insert(Library.Elements, E)
	return E
end

local function attachCommon(E)
	function E:SetVisible(value)
		E._Visible = value ~= false
		if E.Obj and E.Obj.SetVisible then
			pcall(function() E.Obj:SetVisible(E._Visible) end)
		end
		Library:_ApplyVisibility()
	end
	function E:SetDisabled(value)
		E._Disabled = value == true
		if E.Obj and E.Obj.SetDisabled then
			pcall(function() E.Obj:SetDisabled(E._Disabled) end)
		end
	end
	function E:SetText(text)
		E.Text = text
		if E.Obj and E.Obj.SetText then
			pcall(function() E.Obj:SetText(strip(text)) end)
		end
	end
	function E:SetTooltip(text) E.Tooltip = text end
	function E:OnChanged(fn) table.insert(E._OnChanged, fn) end
	function E:_Fire(...) for _, fn in ipairs(E._OnChanged) do safe(fn, ...) end end
	function E:SetValue() end
	function E:Resize() end
	function E:Display() end
	function E:Update() end
	function E:Destroy()
		E.Destroyed = true
		E._Visible = false
		if E.Frame then pcall(function() E.Frame:Destroy() end) end
	end
	function E:SetMenuVisibility() end
	function E:GetState() return E.State == true end
	return E
end

-- ── регистрация элемента в контейнере ────────────────────────────────────────
local function register(container, E)
	E._Tab = container._Tab
	table.insert(container.Elements, E)
	if Library._Built then
		Library:_RefreshTabs()
		Library:_RenderElement(E)
		Library:_ApplyVisibility()
	end
	return E
end

-- ── контейнерные методы (Groupbox / Depbox / Tabbox-tab) ─────────────────────
local function addContainerMethods(C)
	function C:AddToggle(idx, info)     return Library:_NewToggle(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddSlider(idx, info)     return Library:_NewSlider(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddDropdown(idx, info)   return Library:_NewDropdown(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddColorPicker(idx, info) return Library:_NewColorPicker(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddLabel(...)            return Library:_NewLabel(C, ...) end
	function C:AddButton(info)          return Library:_NewButton(C, info) end
	function C:AddButton2(...)          return Library:_NewButton(C, select("#", ...) == 2 and (select(2, ...)) or (select(1, ...))) end
	function C:AddDivider(...)          return Library:_NewDivider(C, ...) end
	function C:AddInput(idx, info)      return Library:_NewInput(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddKeyPicker(idx, info)  return Library:_NewKeyPicker(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddImage(idx, info)      return Library:_NewImage(C, idx, info) end
	function C:AddDependencyBox()       return Library:_NewDependencyBox(C) end
	function C:AddBlank()               return nil end
	function C:AddSeparator(text)       return Library:_NewDivider(C, text) end
	function C:Resize() end
end

local function newContainer(kind, name, tab)
	local C = setmetatable({
		Type = kind, Name = name or "", Elements = {}, _Tab = tab,
	}, ElementMT)
	addContainerMethods(C)
	return C
end

-- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ
-- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function Library:_NewToggle(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Toggle", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Toggle"
	E.Value = info.Default == true

	local function fire(value)
		E.Value = value == true
		safe(info.Callback, E.Value)
		E:_Fire(E.Value)
		Library:_UpdateDepBoxes()
	end

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateToggle({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Default = self.Value,
			Callback = function(value) fire(value) end,
		})
	end
	function E:SetValue(value)
		E.Value = value == true
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(E.Value) end) end
		safe(info.Callback, E.Value)
		E:_Fire(E.Value)
		Library:_UpdateDepBoxes()
	end
	function E:AddColorPicker(subIdx, subInfo) return Library:_NewColorPicker(container, subIdx, subInfo) end
	function E:AddKeyPicker(subIdx, subInfo)   return Library:_NewKeyPicker(container, subIdx, subInfo) end
	function E:_Save() return E.Value end
	function E:_Load(data) E:SetValue(data == true) end

	if idx then Library.Toggles[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewSlider(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Slider", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Slider"
	E.Min = info.Min or 0
	E.Max = info.Max or 100
	E.Suffix = info.Suffix or ""
	local rounding = tonumber(info.Rounding) or 0
	E.Increment = rounding > 0 and (1 / (10 ^ rounding)) or 1
	E.Value = info.Default or E.Min

	local function fire(value)
		E.Value = value
		safe(info.Callback, value)
		E:_Fire(value)
	end

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateSlider({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Min = self.Min,
			Max = self.Max,
			Increment = self.Increment,
			Default = self.Value,
			Callback = function(value) fire(value) end,
		})
		if self.Obj and self.Obj.SetText and self.Suffix ~= "" then
			pcall(function() self.Obj:SetText(strip(self.Text) .. " (" .. self.Suffix .. ")") end)
		end
	end
	function E:SetValue(value)
		E.Value = value
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(value) end) end
		safe(info.Callback, value)
		E:_Fire(value)
	end
	function E:SetMin(v) E.Min = v; if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetMin(v) end) end end
	function E:SetMax(v) E.Max = v; if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetMax(v) end) end end
	function E:SetSuffix(v) E.Suffix = v or "" end
	function E:_Save() return E.Value end
	function E:_Load(data) if type(data) == "number" then E:SetValue(data) end end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

local function playerNames(excludeLocal)
	local list = {}
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if not (excludeLocal and plr == LocalPlayer) then
			table.insert(list, plr.Name)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

function Library:_NewDropdown(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Dropdown", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Dropdown"
	E.Multi = info.Multi == true
	E.AllowNull = info.AllowNull ~= false
	E.SpecialType = info.SpecialType
	E.ExcludeLocalPlayer = info.ExcludeLocalPlayer
	E.Values = info.Values or {}
	if E.SpecialType == "Player" then
		E.Values = playerNames(E.ExcludeLocalPlayer)
	end

	local function displayValue(value)
		if E.Multi then
			local n = 0
			for _ in pairs(value or {}) do n = n + 1 end
			return (n == 0 and "None") or (tostring(n) .. " selected")
		end
		if value == nil or value == "" then return E.AllowNull and "None" or "" end
		if info.FormatDisplayValue then
			return strip(safe(info.FormatDisplayValue, value) or tostring(value))
		end
		return tostring(value)
	end

	local default = info.Default
	if type(default) == "number" then default = E.Values[default] end
	if E.Multi then
		E.Value = {}
		if type(default) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(default) do if v then E.Value[k] = true end end
		elseif type(default) == "string" and default ~= "" then
			E.Value[default] = true
		elseif not E.AllowNull and E.Values[1] then
			E.Value[E.Values[1]] = true
		end
	else
		E.Value = default
		if (E.Value == nil or E.Value == "") and not E.AllowNull and E.Values[1] then
			E.Value = E.Values[1]
		end
	end

	E._Setting = false

	local function refreshTitle()
		if not E.Obj then return end
		E._Setting = true
		pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(displayValue(E.Value)) end)
		E._Setting = false
	end

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateDropdown({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Options = self.Values,
			Default = displayValue(self.Value),
			Callback = function(option)
				if E._Setting then return end
				if E.Multi then
					if E.Value[option] then E.Value[option] = nil else E.Value[option] = true end
					refreshTitle()
					safe(info.Callback, E.Value)
					E:_Fire(E.Value)
				else
					E.Value = option
					refreshTitle()
					safe(info.Callback, option)
					E:_Fire(option)
				end
				Library:_UpdateDepBoxes()
			end,
		})
	end

	function E:SetValue(value)
		if E.Multi then
			E.Value = {}
			if type(value) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(value) do if v then E.Value[k] = true end end
			elseif value ~= nil and value ~= "" then
				E.Value[value] = true
			end
		else
			E.Value = value
		end
		refreshTitle()
		safe(info.Callback, E.Value)
		E:_Fire(E.Value)
		Library:_UpdateDepBoxes()
	end
	function E:SetValues(values)
		E.Values = values or {}
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetValues(E.Values) end) end
		refreshTitle()
	end
	function E:AddValues(values)
		if type(values) == "table" then
			for _, v in ipairs(values) do table.insert(E.Values, v) end
		end
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:AddValues(values) end) end
	end
	function E:SetDisabledValues(values)
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetDisabledValues(values) end) end
	end
	function E:Refresh()
		if E.SpecialType == "Player" then E:SetValues(playerNames(E.ExcludeLocalPlayer)) end
	end
	function E:_Save()
		if E.Multi then
			local out = {}
			for k, v in pairs(E.Value or {}) do if v then table.insert(out, k) end end
			return out
		end
		return E.Value
	end
	function E:_Load(data)
		E:SetValue(data)
	end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end

	-- автообновление списка игроков
	if E.SpecialType == "Player" then
		table.insert(Library.Connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() E:Refresh() end))
		table.insert(Library.Connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() E:Refresh() end))
	end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewColorPicker(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("ColorPicker", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Title or info.Text or "Color"
	E.Value = info.Default or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	E.Transparency = info.Transparency or 0

	local function fire(color, transparency)
		E.Value = color
		if transparency ~= nil then E.Transparency = transparency end
		safe(info.Callback, color, E.Transparency)
		E:_Fire(color, E.Transparency)
	end

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateColorpicker({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Default = self.Value,
			DefaultTransparency = self.Transparency,
			Callback = function(color, transparency) fire(color, transparency) end,
		})
	end
	function E:SetValue(color, transparency)
		E.Value = color or E.Value
		if transparency ~= nil then E.Transparency = transparency end
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(E.Value, E.Transparency) end) end
		safe(info.Callback, E.Value, E.Transparency)
		E:_Fire(E.Value, E.Transparency)
	end
	function E:SetValueRGB(color, transparency) self:SetValue(color, transparency) end
	function E:_Save()
		return { R = E.Value.R, G = E.Value.G, B = E.Value.B, T = E.Transparency }
	end
	function E:_Load(data)
		if type(data) == "table" and data.R then
			self:SetValue(Color3.new(data.R, data.G, data.B), data.T)
		end
	end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewLabel(container, ...)
	local first, second, third = ...
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Label", nil, container))
	local text, idx, doesWrap

	if type(first) == "table" or type(second) == "table" then
		local params = type(first) == "table" and first or second
		text = params.Text or ""
		doesWrap = params.DoesWrap
		idx = type(second) == "table" and first or nil
	else
		text = first or ""
		doesWrap = second
		idx = third or nil
	end

	E.Text = text
	E.DoesWrap = doesWrap
	E.Idx = idx

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateLabel(strip(self.Text))
	end
	function E:AddKeyPicker(subIdx, subInfo)  return Library:_NewKeyPicker(container, subIdx, subInfo) end
	function E:AddColorPicker(subIdx, subInfo) return Library:_NewColorPicker(container, subIdx, subInfo) end

	if idx then Library.Labels[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewDivider(container, text)
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Divider", nil, container))
	E.Text = text or ""
	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateLabel(self.Text ~= "" and ("-- " .. strip(self.Text) .. " --") or string.rep("-", 26))
	end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewButton(container, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Button", nil, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Button"

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateButton({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Callback = function() safe(info.Func or info.Callback) end,
		})
	end
	function E:AddKeyPicker(subIdx, subInfo) return Library:_NewKeyPicker(container, subIdx, subInfo) end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewInput(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Input", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Input"
	E.Value = tostring(info.Default or "")

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateInput({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Default = self.Value,
			Placeholder = info.Placeholder or "",
			Numeric = info.Numeric,
			Callback = function(value)
				E.Value = value
				safe(info.Callback, value)
				E:_Fire(value)
			end,
		})
	end
	function E:SetValue(value)
		E.Value = tostring(value)
		if E.Obj then pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(E.Value) end) end
		safe(info.Callback, E.Value)
	end
	function E:_Save() return E.Value end
	function E:_Load(data) if data ~= nil then E:SetValue(tostring(data)) end end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

local function keyToEnum(key)
	if key == nil or key == "" or key == "None" then return "" end
	if typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then return key end
	local name = tostring(key)
	if Enum.KeyCode[name] then return Enum.KeyCode[name] end
	if Enum.UserInputType[name] then return Enum.UserInputType[name] end
	local map = { MB1 = "MouseButton1", MB2 = "MouseButton2", MB3 = "MouseButton3" }
	if map[name] then return Enum.UserInputType[map[name]] end
	return ""
end

local function keyName(key)
	if key == nil or key == "" then return "None" end
	if typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then return key.Name end
	return tostring(key)
end

function Library:_NewKeyPicker(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("KeyPicker", idx, container))
	E.Text = info.Text or "Keybind"
	E.Mode = info.Mode or "Press"
	E.NoUI = info.NoUI == true
	E.State = false
	E.Value = keyName(keyToEnum(info.Default))

	local function fire(state)
		if state ~= nil then E.State = state == true end
		safe(info.Callback, E.State)
		E:_Fire(E.State)
	end

	E._Create = function(self, W)
		self.Obj = W:CreateBind({
			Name = strip(self.Text),
			Default = self.Value == "None" and "" or self.Value,
			Hold = self.Mode == "Hold",
			Toggle = self.Mode == "Toggle",
			Callback = function(state)
				if self.Mode == "Press" then
					E.State = true
					task.delay(0.12, function() E.State = false end)
					fire(nil)
				else
					fire(state)
				end
			end,
		})
		if self.Obj then
			-- следим за сменой клавиши (ребиндинг делает сама библиотека)
			local original = self.Obj.Set
			if type(original) == "function" then
				E._OrigSet = original
				self.Obj.Set = function(bind, key)
					original(bind, key)
					E.Value = keyName(bind.Key)
					safe(info.ChangedCallback, E.Value, nil)
				end
			end
			if self.NoUI then pcall(function() self.Obj:SetVisible(false) end) end
		end
	end

	function E:SetValue(data)
		local key, mode = data, nil
		if type(data) == "table" then
			key, mode = data[1], data[2]
			if type(mode) == "table" then mode = data[2] end
		end
		if mode then E.Mode = mode end
		local old = E.Value
		E.Value = keyName(keyToEnum(key))
		if E.Obj then
			pcall(function() E.Obj:Set(keyToEnum(key)) end)
		end
		safe(info.ChangedCallback, E.Value, old)
	end
	function E:GetState() return E.State == true end
	function E:IsPressed() return E.State == true end
	function E:_Save() return { E.Value, E.Mode } end
	function E:_Load(data)
		if type(data) == "table" then self:SetValue(data) elseif type(data) == "string" then self:SetValue(data) end
	end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_NewImage(container, idx, info)
	info = info or {}
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("Image", idx, container))
	E.Height = info.Height or 120
	E.Image = info.Image or ""
	E._Create = function(self, W)
		local holder = Library:_Holder()
		if not holder then return end
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Name = "Image"
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, self.Height)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = info.BackgroundTransparency or 1
		frame.Parent = holder

		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Image"
		img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.Image = self.Image
		img.ImageColor3 = info.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		img.ImageTransparency = info.Transparency or 0
		img.ScaleType = info.ScaleType or Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.Parent = frame

		self.Frame = frame
		self.Holder = frame
		self.ImageLabel = img
	end
	function E:SetImage(id) E.Image = id; if E.ImageLabel then E.ImageLabel.Image = id end end
	function E:SetHeight(h) E.Height = h; if E.Frame then E.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h) end end
	function E:SetColor(c) if E.ImageLabel then E.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = c end end
	function E:SetTransparency(v) if E.ImageLabel then E.ImageLabel.ImageTransparency = v end end
	function E:SetScaleType(v) if E.ImageLabel then E.ImageLabel.ScaleType = v end end

	if idx then Library.Options[idx] = E end
	return register(container, E)
end

-- ── DependencyBox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Library:_NewDependencyBox(container)
	local E = attachCommon(newElement("DependencyBox", nil, container))
	E.Elements = {}
	E.Deps = {}
	addContainerMethods(E)

	function E:SetupDependencies(deps)
		E.Deps = deps or {}
		E:Update()
	end
	E._Create = function(self, W)
		for _, child in ipairs(self.Elements) do
			Library:_RenderElement(child)
		end
	end
	function E:Update()
		local ok = true
		for _, dep in ipairs(E.Deps) do
			local option, need = dep[1], dep[2]
			local value = option and option.Value
			if type(need) == "table" then
				if not need[value] then ok = false end
			elseif type(value) == "table" then
				if not value[need] then ok = false end
			elseif value ~= need then
				ok = false
			end
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(E.Elements) do
			child._DepHidden = not ok
		end
		Library:_ApplyVisibility()
	end
	table.insert(Library.DepBoxes, E)
	return register(container, E)
end

function Library:_UpdateDepBoxes()
	for _, box in ipairs(Library.DepBoxes) do
		safe(function() box:Update() end)
	end
end

-- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  ОКНО / ВКЛАДКИ
-- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function Library:_NewBox(parent, name, side, kind)
	local box = newContainer(kind, name, parent._Tab or parent)
	box.Side = side
	if parent.Type == "Tab" then
		parent.Boxes[side] = parent.Boxes[side] or {}
		table.insert(parent.Boxes[side], box)
		if kind == "Tabbox" then
			box.Tabs = {}
			function box:AddTab(tabName)
				local sub = newContainer("Groupbox", tabName, parent._Tab or parent)
				sub.Elements = {}
				table.insert(box.Tabs, sub)
				return sub
			end
		end
	elseif parent.Type == "Tabbox" then
		parent.Tabs = parent.Tabs or {}
		table.insert(parent.Tabs, box)
	end
	return box
end

function Library:CreateWindow(info)
	info = info or {}
	Library._Title = strip(info.Title or "Owner sigma hub")
	Library._Footer = strip(info.Footer or "")
	Library._TabOrder = {}
	Library.CornerRadius = info.CornerRadius or Library.CornerRadius
	Library.ToggleKeybind = info.ToggleKeybind or Library.ToggleKeybind

	local Window = setmetatable({ Type = "Window", Tabs = {} }, ElementMT)

	function Window:AddTab(name, icon, description)
		local tab = setmetatable({
			Type = "Tab", Name = name or "Tab", Icon = icon, Description = description,
			Boxes = { Left = {}, Right = {} },
			Sides = {},
		}, ElementMT)
		function tab:AddLeftGroupbox(n)   return Library:_NewBox(tab, n, "Left", "Groupbox") end
		function tab:AddRightGroupbox(n)  return Library:_NewBox(tab, n, "Right", "Groupbox") end
		function tab:AddGroupbox(n)       return Library:_NewBox(tab, n, "Left", "Groupbox") end
		function tab:AddLeftTabbox(n)     return Library:_NewBox(tab, n, "Left", "Tabbox") end
		function tab:AddRightTabbox(n)    return Library:_NewBox(tab, n, "Right", "Tabbox") end
		function tab:UpdateWarningBox() end
		function tab:Show() end
		function tab:Hide() end
		function tab:Resize() end
		function tab:SetTooltip() end

		Library.Tabs[name] = tab
		table.insert(Library._TabOrder, tab)
		table.insert(Window.Tabs, tab)
		return tab
	end

	function Window:AddDialog(_, dialogInfo)
		return Library:_ShowDialog(dialogInfo or {})
	end
	function Window:SetCornerRadius(v) Library.CornerRadius = v end
	function Window:SetSidebarWidth(v) Library._SidebarWidth = v end
	function Window:GetSidebarWidth() return Library._SidebarWidth or 150 end
	function Window:ChangeTitle(t) Library._Title = strip(t or Library._Title) end
	function Window:SetFooter(t) Library._Footer = strip(t or "") end
	function Window:SetBackgroundImage() end
	function Window:SetAlwaysOnTop() end
	function Window:SetCompact() end
	function Window:SetAnimations() end
	function Window:SetSnapping() end
	function Window:Toggle() end
	function Window:HideTabInfo() end
	function Window:ShowTabInfo() end
	function Window:IsSidebarCompacted() return false end

	-- Main код хаба работает с этими объектами напрямую — создаём их сразу,
	-- чтобы не было nil до построения окна
	local root = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	root.Name = "OSH_Root"
	root.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	root.Parent = CoreGui

	local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mainFrame.Parent = root

	Library.ScreenGui = root
	Library.KeybindFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	Library.KeybindFrame.Name = "KeybindFrame"
	Library.KeybindFrame.Visible = false
	Library.KeybindFrame.Parent = root
	Window.MainFrame = mainFrame

	Library.Window = Window
	task.delay(0.75, function() Library:_Build() end)
	return Window
end

-- ── построение интерфейса ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Library:_Holder()
	if self._HolderFrame and self._HolderFrame.Parent then return self._HolderFrame end
	local gui = self.ScreenGui
	if not gui then return nil end
	local main = gui:FindFirstChild("MainWindow")
	local holder = main and main:FindFirstChild("MainWindowHolder")
	local fake = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("FakeHolder")
	local frame = fake and fake:FindFirstChild("HolderFrame")
	self._HolderFrame = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	return self._HolderFrame
end

function Library:_RenderElement(E)
	if E.Rendered or E.Destroyed then return end
	E.Rendered = true
	if type(E._Create) ~= "function" then return end
	local ok = pcall(E._Create, E, self._Win)
	if not ok then return end
	if E.Obj and E.Obj.Frame then E.Frame = E.Obj.Frame end
	if E._Visible == false and E.Frame then pcall(function() E.Frame.Visible = false end) end
	if E._Disabled and E.Obj and E.Obj.SetDisabled then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetDisabled(true) end) end
	if E.NoUI and E.Obj and E.Obj.SetVisible then pcall(function() E.Obj:SetVisible(false) end) end
end

function Library:_ApplyVisibility()
	for _, E in ipairs(Library.Elements) do
		if E.Frame then
			local visible = E._Visible ~= false and not E._DepHidden
			if E._Tab and self._Active and E._Tab.Name ~= self._Active then visible = false end
			pcall(function() E.Frame.Visible = visible end)
		end
	end
end

function Library:_RefreshTabs()
	if not (self._Built and self._Switcher) then return end
	if self._SwitcherCount == #self._TabOrder then return end
	self._SwitcherCount = #self._TabOrder
	local names, map = {}, {}
	for _, tab in ipairs(self._TabOrder) do
		local clean = strip(tab.Name)
		table.insert(names, clean)
		map[clean] = tab.Name
	end
	self._TabMap = map
	pcall(function()
		self._Switcher._Setting = true
		self._Switcher:SetValues(names)
		self._Switcher._Setting = false
	end)
	if not self._Active and #names > 0 then
		self:_SelectTab(map[names[1]])
	end
end

function Library:_SelectTab(name)
	self._Active = name
	if self._Switcher then
		pcall(function()
			self._Switcher._Setting = true
			self._Switcher:Set(strip(name or ""))
			self._Switcher._Setting = false
		end)
	end
	self:_ApplyVisibility()
	local holder = self:_Holder()
	if holder then
		pcall(function() holder.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) end)
	end
end

function Library:_Build()
	if self._Built then return end
	self._Built = true

	local title = self._Title or "Owner sigma hub"
	local ok, win = pcall(function()
		return TheWorstUI:CreateWindow({ Name = title, SizeX = 280, SizeY = 460, CanResize = "BOTH" })
	end)
	if not ok or not win then
		warn("[OSH-UI] failed to create window: " .. tostring(win))
		return
	end
	self._Win = win
	local realGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("TheWorstUI-" .. title)
	if realGui then
		-- сначала перекидываем MainFrame, потом удаляем временный gui
		if self.Window and self.Window.MainFrame then
			pcall(function() self.Window.MainFrame.Parent = realGui end)
		end
		if self.ScreenGui and self.ScreenGui ~= realGui and self.ScreenGui.Name == "OSH_Root" then
			pcall(function() self.ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
		end
		self.ScreenGui = realGui
		local keybindFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		keybindFrame.Name = "KeybindFrame"
		keybindFrame.Visible = false
		keybindFrame.Parent = realGui
		self.KeybindFrame = keybindFrame
	end

	if self._Footer and self._Footer ~= "" then
		pcall(function() win:CreateLabel(self._Footer) end)
	end

	-- переключатель вкладок
	local names, map = {}, {}
	for _, tab in ipairs(self._TabOrder) do
		local clean = strip(tab.Name)
		table.insert(names, clean)
		map[clean] = tab.Name
	end
	self._TabMap = map
	self._SwitcherCount = #names
	if #names > 0 then
		self._Switcher = win:CreateDropdown({
			Name = "Tab",
			Options = names,
			Default = names[1],
			Callback = function(value)
				if self._Switcher and self._Switcher._Setting then return end
				self:_SelectTab(map[value] or value)
			end,
		})
	end

	-- содержимое
	for _, tab in ipairs(self._TabOrder) do
		for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
			for _, box in ipairs(tab.Boxes[side] or {}) do
				if box.Type == "Tabbox" then
					pcall(function() win:CreateLabel(">> " .. strip(box.Name)) end)
					for _, sub in ipairs(box.Tabs or {}) do
						pcall(function() win:CreateLabel("   -- " .. strip(sub.Name) .. " --") end)
						for _, E in ipairs(sub.Elements) do self:_RenderElement(E) end
					end
				else
					pcall(function() win:CreateLabel("-- " .. strip(box.Name) .. " --") end)
					for _, E in ipairs(box.Elements) do self:_RenderElement(E) end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self._Active = self._TabOrder[1] and self._TabOrder[1].Name or nil
	self:_ApplyVisibility()
	self:_StartKeybindListener()
end

function Library:_StartKeybindListener()
	if self._KeyListener then return end
	self._KeyListener = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then return end
		local bind = self.ToggleKeybind
		local key = nil
		if typeof(bind) == "EnumItem" then
			key = bind
		elseif type(bind) == "table" then
			key = keyToEnum(bind.Value)
		elseif type(bind) == "string" then
			key = keyToEnum(bind)
		end
		if not key or key == "" then return end
		if input.KeyCode == key or input.UserInputType == key then
			if self.ScreenGui then
				self.ScreenGui.Enabled = not self.ScreenGui.Enabled
			end
		end
	end)
	table.insert(self.Connections, self._KeyListener)
end

-- ── диалог ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Library:_ShowDialog(info)
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "OSH_Dialog"
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = CoreGui

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 170)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -85)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui
	Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = strip(info.Title or "Dialog")
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.Parent = frame

	local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 70)
	desc.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
	desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	desc.Text = strip(info.Description or "")
	desc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	desc.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	desc.TextSize = 14
	desc.TextWrapped = true
	desc.Parent = frame

	local function dismiss()
		pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
	end

	local buttons = info.FooterButtons or {}
	table.sort(buttons, function(a, b) return (a.Order or 0) < (b.Order or 0) end)
	local count = #buttons
	local width = math.floor(360 / math.max(count, 1)) - 8
	for index, button in ipairs(buttons) do
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 34)
		btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + (index - 1) * (width + 8), 1, -44)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Text = strip(button.Title or "OK")
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 14
		btn.Parent = frame
		Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			safe(button.Callback)
			dismiss()
		end)
	end

	local Dialog = setmetatable({ Type = "Dialog" }, ElementMT)
	function Dialog:Dismiss() dismiss() end
	function Dialog:SetTitle() end
	function Dialog:SetDescription() end
	function Dialog:Resize() end
	function Dialog:AddFooterButton() end
	function Dialog:RemoveFooterButton() end
	function Dialog:SetButtonDisabled() end
	function Dialog:SetButtonOrder() end
	return Dialog
end

-- ── плавающие элементы ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function makeDraggable(kind, text, second, third)
	-- поддерживаем оба варианта вызова:
	--   AddDraggableLabel(text) / AddDraggableLabel(text, iconId)
	--   AddDraggableButton(text, callback)
	local info = {}
	info.Text = type(text) == "string" and text or (type(text) == "table" and (text.Text or "")) or ""
	if type(second) == "function" then
		info.Callback = second
	elseif second ~= nil then
		info.Icon = tostring(second)
	end
	if type(third) == "function" then info.Callback = third end
	if type(text) == "table" then
		info.Callback = info.Callback or text.Callback
		info.Icon = info.Icon or text.Icon
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "OSH_Draggable"
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = CoreGui

	local frame
	if kind == "Button" then
		frame = Instance.new("TextButton")
	else
		frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	end
	frame.Name = kind
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 34)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 120)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Text = strip(info.Text)
	frame.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	frame.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	frame.TextSize = 14
	frame.Active = true
	frame.Parent = gui
	Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

	local icon
	if info.Icon then
		icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		icon.Name = "Icon"
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
		icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -10)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.Image = tostring(info.Icon)
		icon.Parent = frame
	end

	-- перетаскивание
	pcall(function()
		local dragging, dragInput, startPos, startInput = false, nil, nil, nil
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				startPos = frame.Position
				startInput = input.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
				end)
			end
		end)
		frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput and dragging then
				local delta = input.Position - startInput
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			end
		end)
	end)

	local Obj = setmetatable({
		Type = "Draggable" .. kind,
		Frame = frame,
		Label = frame,
		Button = frame,
		Icon = icon,
		Gui = gui,
	}, ElementMT)

	function Obj:SetText(value) frame.Text = strip(value) end
	function Obj:SetVisible(value) gui.Enabled = value ~= false end
	function Obj:SetIcon(id)
		if not icon then
			icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			icon.Name = "Icon"
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
			icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -10)
			icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			icon.Parent = frame
			Obj.Icon = icon
		end
		icon.Image = tostring(id or "")
	end
	function Obj:SetIconSize(w, h) if icon then icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w or 20, h or 20) end end
	function Obj:SetIconPosition(pos) if icon then icon.Position = pos end end
	function Obj:SetNormal() end
	function Obj:Destroy() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
	if info.Callback then
		frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() safe(info.Callback) end)
	end
	return Obj
end

function Library:AddDraggableButton(text, second, third) return makeDraggable("Button", text, second, third) end
function Library:AddDraggableLabel(text, second, third)  return makeDraggable("Label", text, second, third) end
function Library:AddDraggableImageButton(text, second, third) return makeDraggable("Button", text, second, third) end
function Library:AddDraggableMenu() return nil end

function Library:GiveSignal(connection)
	table.insert(self.Connections, connection)
	return connection
end
function Library:OnUnload(callback)
	table.insert(self.UnloadCallbacks, callback)
end
function Library:Unload()
	if self.Unloaded then return end
	self.Unloaded = true
	for _, callback in ipairs(self.UnloadCallbacks) do safe(callback) end
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.Connections) do
		if typeof(connection) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
		end
	end
	pcall(function()
		for _, child in ipairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and (child.Name == "TheWorstUI-" .. tostring(self._Title)
				or child.Name == "OSH_Notifications" or child.Name == "OSH_Dialog" or child.Name == "OSH_Draggable") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
	pcall(function() TheWorstUI:Unload() end)
end

function Library:SetNotifySide(side) self.NotifySide = side or "Right" end
function Library:SetWatermark() end
function Library:SetWatermarkVisibility() end

function Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry() end
function Library:MakeDraggable() end
function Library:MakeResizable() end
function Library:GetIcon() return nil end
function Library:GetKeyString(key) return keyName(key) end
function Library:SafeCallback(fn, ...) return safe(fn, ...) end
function Library:Validate(default, value) return value ~= nil and value or default end

Library.__index = Library
return Library

sources['SaveManager'] = [====[
--[[ Owner Sigma Hub — SaveManager (конфиги под TheWorstUI) ]]
local requireModule = ...
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local SaveManager = {
	Library = nil,
	Folder = "OwnerSigmaHub",
	IgnoreIndexes = {},
	IgnoreTheme = false,
	Configs = {},
}

local hasFS = typeof(writefile) == "function" and typeof(readfile) == "function" and typeof(isfolder) == "function"

local function safe(fn, ...)
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
	if not ok then return nil end
	return result
end

function SaveManager:SetLibrary(lib)
	self.Library = lib
end

function SaveManager:SetFolder(folder)
	self.Folder = tostring(folder or self.Folder)
end

function SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes(indexes)
	self.IgnoreIndexes = {}
	for _, index in ipairs(indexes or {}) do
		self.IgnoreIndexes[index] = true
	end
end

function SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
	self.IgnoreTheme = true
end

local function path(name)
	return SaveManager.Folder .. "/" .. tostring(name) .. ".json"
end

local function ensureFolder()
	if not hasFS then return false end
	if not isfolder(SaveManager.Folder) then
		pcall(function() makefolder(SaveManager.Folder) end)
	end
	return true
end

function SaveManager:RefreshConfigList()
	self.Configs = {}
	if not hasFS then return self.Configs end
	ensureFolder()
	local files = safe(listfiles, self.Folder) or {}
	for _, file in ipairs(files) do
		local name = tostring(file):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
		if name then table.insert(self.Configs, name) end
	end
	table.sort(self.Configs)
	return self.Configs
end

local function buildTable()
	local data = { toggles = {}, options = {} }
	local lib = SaveManager.Library
	if not lib then return data end
	for index, element in pairs(lib.Toggles or {}) do
		if not SaveManager.IgnoreIndexes[index] and type(element._Save) == "function" then
			data.toggles[index] = element:_Save()
		end
	end
	for index, element in pairs(lib.Options or {}) do
		if not SaveManager.IgnoreIndexes[index] and type(element._Save) == "function" then
			if not (SaveManager.IgnoreTheme and element.Type == "ColorPicker") then
				data.options[index] = element:_Save()
			end
		end
	end
	return data
end

local function applyTable(data)
	local lib = SaveManager.Library
	if not lib or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	for index, value in pairs(data.toggles or {}) do
		local element = lib.Toggles and lib.Toggles[index]
		if element and type(element._Load) == "function" then
			pcall(function() element:_Load(value) end)
		end
	end
	for index, value in pairs(data.options or {}) do
		local element = lib.Options and lib.Options[index]
		if element and type(element._Load) == "function" then
			pcall(function() element:_Load(value) end)
		end
	end
end

function SaveManager:Save(name)
	if not name or name == "" then return false, "no name" end
	if not ensureFolder() then return false, "no filesystem" end
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(buildTable()) end)
	if not ok then return false, encoded end
	local written = safe(writefile, path(name), encoded)
	if written == nil then return false, "write failed" end
	self:RefreshConfigList()
	return true, name
end

function SaveManager:Load(name)
	if not hasFS then return false, "no filesystem" end
	local content = safe(readfile, path(name))
	if not content then return false, "not found" end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return false, "bad json" end
	applyTable(data)
	return true, data
end

function SaveManager:Delete(name)
	if not hasFS then return false, "no filesystem" end
	local removed = safe(delfile, path(name))
	self:RefreshConfigList()
	return removed ~= nil, name
end

-- совместимость со старым API
function SaveManager:SaveJSON(name, data)
	if data ~= nil and type(data) == "table" then
		if not ensureFolder() then return false, "no filesystem" end
		local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
		if not ok then return false, encoded end
		if safe(writefile, path(name), encoded) == nil then return false, "write failed" end
		return true, name
	end
	return self:Save(name)
end

function SaveManager:LoadJSON(name, content)
	if type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
		if not ok then return false, data end
		return true, data
	end
	return self:Load(name)
end

function SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
	if not hasFS then return false end
	if safe(isfile, path("autoload")) then
		return self:Load("autoload")
	end
	return false
end

function SaveManager:SetAutoloadConfig(name)
	if not ensureFolder() then return false end
	if safe(writefile, path("autoload"), "true") == nil then return false end
	return true
end

function SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(tab)
	if not tab then return end
	self:RefreshConfigList()

	local box
	pcall(function() box = tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Configuration") end)
	if not box then return end

	local selected = self.Configs[1] or ""

	local dropdown
	dropdown = box:AddDropdown("ConfigsDropdown", {
		Text = "Configs",
		Values = self.Configs,
		Default = selected,
		AllowNull = true,
		Callback = function(value) selected = value end,
	})

	box:AddInput("ConfigName", {
		Text = "Config name",
		Default = "",
		Placeholder = "name",
		Callback = function() end,
	})

	local nameInput
	pcall(function() nameInput = self.Library and self.Library.Options and self.Library.Options.ConfigName end)

	local function refresh()
		local list = self:RefreshConfigList()
		if dropdown then dropdown:SetValues(list) end
	end

	box:AddButton({
		Text = "Save config",
		Callback = function()
			local name = nameInput and nameInput.Value or ""
			if name == "" then
				if self.Library then
					self.Library:Notify({ Title = "Configs", Description = "Enter a name first", Time = 3 })
				end
				return
			end
			local ok, err = self:Save(name)
			refresh()
			if self.Library then
				self.Library:Notify({ Title = "Configs", Description = ok and ("Saved: " .. name) or ("Error: " .. tostring(err)), Time = 3 })
			end
		end,
	})

	box:AddButton({
		Text = "Load config",
		Callback = function()
			local ok, err = self:Load(selected)
			if self.Library then
				self.Library:Notify({ Title = "Configs", Description = ok and ("Loaded: " .. selected) or ("Error: " .. tostring(err)), Time = 3 })
			end
		end,
	})

	box:AddButton({
		Text = "Delete config",
		Callback = function()
			self:Delete(selected)
			refresh()
		end,
	})

	box:AddButton({
		Text = "Refresh list",
		Callback = function() refresh() end,
	})
end

return SaveManager

}
UI.__index = UI

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local gethui = gethui or get_hidden_ui or get_hidden_gui
local cloneref = cloneref or clonereference or function(i) return i end
local CoreGui = (typeof(gethui) == 'function' and gethui()) or cloneref(game:GetService('CoreGui'))
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local function AddConnection(Connection, Function, Name)
    local Conn = Connection:Connect(Function)
    UI.Connections[Name ~= nil and Name or #UI.Connections+1] = Conn
    return Conn
end

local function RemoveConnection(Connection)
    if UI.Connections[Connection] ~= nil then
        UI.Connections[Connection]:Disconnect()
        UI.Connections[Connection] = nil
    end
end

local function CreateElement(Name, Props)
    local Element = Instance.new(Name)
    for i, v in Props or {} do Element[i] = v end
    return Element
end

local function SetChildren(Parent, Children)
    for i, v in Children do v.Parent = Parent end
    return Parent
end

local function PlayTween(...)
    local Parent, Info, Args = table.unpack({...})
    Info = TweenInfo.new(typeof(Info) == "table" and table.unpack(Info) or Info)
    
    local Tween = TweenService:Create(Parent, Info, Args); Tween:Play()
    return Tween
end

local function AnimateNeighbor(Index, Size)
    if not UI.ElementInput then
        local Neighbor = UI.Elements[Index]
        if Neighbor and not Neighbor:GetAttribute("Opened") then
            PlayTween(Neighbor, 0.1, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Size)})
        end
    end
end

local function Round(Number, Factor)
    Number = tonumber(Number)

    local sign = Number >= 0 and 1 or -1
    local result = math.floor(Number / Factor + 0.5 * sign) * Factor

    if result < 0 then
        result = result + Factor
    end

    if Factor < 1 then
        local str = tostring(Factor)
        local dot = str:find("%.")
        local precision = dot and #str - dot or 0
        result = tonumber(string.format("%." .. precision .. "f", result))
    end

    return result
end

function UI:Unload()
    for Key, Conn in pairs(UI.Connections) do
        if typeof(Conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            Conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end

    table.clear(UI.Connections)
    table.clear(UI.Elements)
    
    if UI.ScreenGui then
        UI.ScreenGui:Destroy()
        UI.ScreenGui = nil
    end
    UI.Window = nil
end

    local function AddDraggingFunctionality(DragPoint: Instance, Main: Instance)
        pcall(function()
            local Dragging, DragInput, MousePos, FramePos = false
            
            local function SaveLayout()
                pcall(function()
                    if writefile then
                        local data = {
                            X_Scale = Main.Position.X.Scale,
                            X_Offset = Main.Position.X.Offset,
                            Y_Scale = Main.Position.Y.Scale,
                            Y_Offset = Main.Position.Y.Offset,
                            SizeX = Main.Size.X.Offset,
                            SizeY = Main.Size.Y.Offset
                        }
                        writefile(FileName, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
                    end
                end)
            end

            DragPoint.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    Dragging = true
                    MousePos = Input.Position
                    FramePos = Main.Position

                    Input.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then 
                            Dragging = false 
                            task.delay(0.22, SaveLayout)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            DragPoint.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
                    DragInput = Input 
                end
            end)
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input == DragInput and Dragging then
                    local Delta = Input.Position - MousePos
                    PlayTween(Main, {0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out}, {
                        Position  = UDim2.new(FramePos.X.Scale,FramePos.X.Offset + Delta.X, FramePos.Y.Scale, FramePos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
                    }):Play()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end; AddDraggingFunctionality(TopBar, MainWindow)

    local function AddResizingFunctionality(ResizePoint: Instance, Main: Instance)
        pcall(function()  
            local Dragging, DragInput, MousePos, FrameSize = false
            local Clamp, Sized = false, false
            
            local function SaveLayout()
                pcall(function()
                    if writefile then
                        local data = {
                            X_Scale = Main.Position.X.Scale,
                            X_Offset = Main.Position.X.Offset,
                            Y_Scale = Main.Position.Y.Scale,
                            Y_Offset = Main.Position.Y.Offset,
                            SizeX = Main.Size.X.Offset,
                            SizeY = Main.Size.Y.Offset
                        }
                        writefile(FileName, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
                    end
                end)
            end

            ResizePoint.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    Dragging = true
                    MousePos = Input.Position
                    FrameSize = Main.Size
                    Clamp = false

                    Input.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                            Dragging = false 
                            Sizing = false
                            Clamp = false
                            task.delay(0.22, SaveLayout)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            
            ResizePoint.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
                    DragInput = Input 
                end
            end)
            
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
                if Input == DragInput and Dragging then
                    Sizing = true
                    local Delta = Input.Position - MousePos
                    
                    local X, Y = FrameSize.X.Offset, FrameSize.Y.Offset
                    if WindowConfig.CanResize == "BOTH" or WindowConfig.CanResize == "X" then X = math.clamp(FrameSize.X.Offset + Delta.X, 160, 9999) end
                    if WindowConfig.CanResize == "BOTH" or WindowConfig.CanResize == "Y" then 
                        if Tab.Opened then Y = FrameSize.Y.Offset + Delta.Y end
                    end

                    local HolderSizeY = HolderFrame.Holder.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 55
                    local SizeChanged = false
                    
                    if WindowConfig.CanResize == "BOTH" or WindowConfig.CanResize == "Y" then
                        if not Clamp then
                            if math.abs(Y - HolderSizeY) <= 20 then
                                Y = HolderSizeY
                                Sized = true
                                Clamp = true
                                SizeChanged = true
                            else
                                Y = math.clamp(Y, 50, 9999)
                            end
                        else
                            if math.abs(Delta.Y) > 30 then
                                Sized = false
                                Y = math.clamp(HolderSizeY + Delta.Y, 50, 9999)
                                Clamp = false
                                SizeChanged = true
                            else
                                Y = HolderSizeY
                                WindowConfig.SizeY = 0
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    local size = UDim2.new(
                        FrameSize.X.Scale, X,
                        FrameSize.Y.Scale, Y
                    ); PlayTween(Main, {0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out}, {Size = size})

                    WindowConfig.Size = size
                    WindowConfig.SizeX = X
                    if WindowConfig.CanResize == "BOTH" or WindowConfig.CanResize == "Y" then 
                        if not Sized then WindowConfig.SizeY = Y end 
                    end
                    if SizeChanged then FrameSize = size; MousePos = Input.Position end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end; AddResizingFunctionality(FakeResizingFrame.ResizingFrame, MainWindow)

    function Tab:ScrollToBottom() 
        HolderFrame.Holder.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, HolderFrame.Holder.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y) 
    end

    function Tab:CreateButton(ButtonConfig: table?): table
        ButtonConfig = ButtonConfig or {}
        ButtonConfig.Name = ButtonConfig.Name or "Button"
        ButtonConfig.Callback = ButtonConfig.Callback or function() end

        local Button = { Name = ButtonConfig.Name }

        local ButtonFrame = SetChildren(CreateElement("Frame", {
            Parent = HolderFrame.Holder,

        }), {
            CreateElement("TextLabel", {
                Name = "Title",
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                Text = ButtonConfig.Name,
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
                TextSize = 15,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            }),
            CreateElement("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)}),
            CreateElement("UIStroke", {
                Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                Thickness = 1,
                Transparency = 0.5
            })
        }); UI.Elements[ButtonNumber] = ButtonFrame

        AddConnection(ButtonFrame.InputEnded, function(Input)
            if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local Tween = PlayTween(ButtonFrame.UIStroke, 0.15, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)})
            Tween.Completed:Once(function() PlayTween(ButtonFrame.UIStroke, 0.15, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)}) end)
            ButtonConfig.Callback()
        end)

        local function AnimateSizeNearButtons(Size)
            if ButtonNumber - 1 ~= 0 then AnimateNeighbor(ButtonNumber - 1, Size) end
            if ButtonNumber + 1 <= #UI.Elements then AnimateNeighbor(ButtonNumber + 1, Size) end
        end

        AddConnection(ButtonFrame.MouseEnter, function() 
            if UI.ElementInput then return end
            PlayTween(ButtonFrame, 0.2, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)}) 
            PlayTween(ButtonFrame.Title, 0.2, {TextSize = 20}) 
            AnimateSizeNearButtons(25)
        end)

        AddConnection(ButtonFrame.MouseLeave, function() 
            if UI.ElementInput then return end
            PlayTween(ButtonFrame, 0.2, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)}) 
            PlayTween(ButtonFrame.Title, 0.2, {TextSize = 15}) 
            AnimateSizeNearButtons(30)
        end)

        Button.Frame = ButtonFrame
        function Button:SetVisible(Value) ButtonFrame.Visible = Value ~= false end
        function Button:SetDisabled(Value) Button.Disabled = Value == true; ButtonFrame.BackgroundTransparency = Value and 0.98 or 0.9 end
        function Button:SetText(Text)
            Button.Name = tostring(Text)
            local L = ButtonFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if L then L.Text = Button.Name end
        end
        Button.Title = ButtonFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        return Button
    end

    function Tab:CreateToggle(ToggleConfig: table?): table
        ToggleConfig = ToggleConfig or {}
        ToggleConfig.Name = ToggleConfig.Name or "Toggle"
        ToggleConfig.Default = ToggleConfig.Default or false
        ToggleConfig.Callback = ToggleConfig.Callback or function() end

        local Toggle = { Name = ToggleConfig.Name, State = ToggleConfig.Default }
        local ToggleNumber = #UI.Elements + 1

        local ToggleFrame = SetChildren(CreateElement("Frame", {
            Parent = HolderFrame.Holder,
            Name = "Toggle",
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        }), {
            CreateElement("TextLabel", {
                Name = "Title",
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                Text = ToggleConfig.Name,
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
                TextSize = 15,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
