        do
                local RainbowMapBox = tbl15.Visual:AddRightGroupbox("Rainbow Map", "palette")
                local rainbowSaved = nil
                local rainbowEffect = nil
                local rainbowConnection = nil
                local rainbowParts = nil

                local function restoreRainbowParts()
                        if not rainbowParts then
                                return
                        end

                        for part, color in pairs(rainbowParts) do
                                if part and part.Parent then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                part.Color = color
                                        end)
                                end
                        end

                        table.clear(rainbowParts)
                        rainbowParts = nil
                end

                local function stopRainbowMap()
                        if rainbowConnection then
                                pcall(function()
                                        rainbowConnection:Disconnect()
                                end)
                                rainbowConnection = nil
                        end

                        if rainbowEffect then
                                pcall(function()
                                        rainbowEffect:Destroy()
                                end)
                                rainbowEffect = nil
                        end

                        restoreRainbowParts()

                        if rainbowSaved then
                                pcall(function()
                                        Lighting.Ambient = rainbowSaved.Ambient
                                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rainbowSaved.OutdoorAmbient
                                        Lighting.FogColor = rainbowSaved.FogColor
                                        Lighting.ColorShift_Top = rainbowSaved.ColorShift_Top
                                        Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = rainbowSaved.ColorShift_Bottom
                                end)

                                local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

                                if atmosphere and rainbowSaved.AtmosphereColor then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                atmosphere.Color = rainbowSaved.AtmosphereColor
                                                atmosphere.Decay = rainbowSaved.AtmosphereDecay
                                        end)
                                end

                                rainbowSaved = nil
                        end
                end

                local function startRainbowMap()
                        rainbowSaved = {
                                Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
                                OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
                                FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
                                ColorShift_Top = Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
                                ColorShift_Bottom = Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom,
                        }

                        local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

                        if atmosphere then
                                rainbowSaved.AtmosphereColor = atmosphere.Color
                                rainbowSaved.AtmosphereDecay = atmosphere.Decay
                        end

                        rainbowEffect = Lighting:FindFirstChild("OwnerSigmaRainbowMap")

                        if not rainbowEffect then
                                rainbowEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                                rainbowEffect.Name = "OwnerSigmaRainbowMap"
                                rainbowEffect.Parent = Lighting
                        end

                        rainbowEffect.Saturation = 0.45
                        rainbowEffect.Contrast = 0.05

                        if tbl8.RainbowMapParts then
                                rainbowParts = {}
                                local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")

                                if mapFolder then
                                        local count = 0

                                        for _, part in ipairs(mapFolder:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
                                                if count >= 500 then
                                                        break
                                                end

                                                rainbowParts[part] = part.Color
                                                count += 1
                                        end
                                end
                        end

                        local lastUpdate = 0

                        rainbowConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                                if flag11 or not tbl8.RainbowMap then
                                        return
                                end

                                local now3 = os.clock()

                                if now3 - lastUpdate < 0.1 then
                                        return
                                end

                                lastUpdate = now3

                                local hue = (now3 * 0.1) % 1
                                local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

                                pcall(function()
                                        Lighting.Ambient = color
                                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = color
                                        Lighting.FogColor = color
                                        Lighting.ColorShift_Top = color
                                        Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = color
                                end)

                                local atmosphere2 = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

                                if atmosphere2 then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                atmosphere2.Color = color
                                                atmosphere2.Decay = color
                                        end)
                                end

                                if rainbowEffect then
                                        rainbowEffect.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.5) % 1, 0.35, 1)
                                end

                                if rainbowParts then
                                        for part in pairs(rainbowParts) do
                                                if part and part.Parent then
                                                        pcall(function()
                                                                part.Color = color
                                                        end)
                                                else
                                                        rainbowParts[part] = nil
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                        end)
                end

                RainbowMapBox:AddToggle("RainbowMapT", {
                        Text = "Rainbow Map",
                        Default = false,
                        Tooltip = "Makes the whole world / map rainbow",
                        Callback = function(arg)
                                tbl8.RainbowMap = arg
                                stopRainbowMap()

                                if arg and not flag11 then
                                        startRainbowMap()
                                end
                        end,
                })

                RainbowMapBox:AddToggle("RainbowMapPartsT", {
                        Text = "Paint Map Parts",
                        Default = false,
                        Tooltip = "Also recolours the map parts themselves (heavier on fps)",
                        Callback = function(arg)
                                tbl8.RainbowMapParts = arg

                                if tbl8.RainbowMap and not flag11 then
                                        stopRainbowMap()
                                        startRainbowMap()
                                end
                        end,
                })
        end

        do
                local Camera = tbl15.Visual:AddRightGroupbox("Camera", "camera")

                Camera:AddToggle("DisableBlurT", {
                        Text = "Disable Ragdoll Blur",
                        Default = false,
                        Callback = function(arg)
                                local blur = currentCamera.Blur

                                if blur then
                                        blur.Enabled = not arg
                                end
                        end,
                })

                Camera:AddDivider()

                Camera:AddSlider("FOVsl", {
                        Text = "FOV",
                        Default = 70,
                        Min = 30,
                        Max = 120,
                        Callback = function(arg)
                                tbl12.SetFOV(arg, false)
                        end,
                })

                Camera:AddDivider()

                local function fn21(localTransparencyModifier)
                        if not localTransparencyModifier then
                                return
                        end
                        local v20 = tbl12.Char()
                        if not (v20 and v20:FindFirstChild("Head")) then
                                return
                        end

                        if (currentCamera.CFrame.Position - currentCamera.Focus.Position).Magnitude > 1.5 then
                                localTransparencyModifier = 0
                        end

                        for _, child in ipairs(v20:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "Head" and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and child.Name ~= "Torso" then
                                        child.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier
                                end
                        end
                end

                local function fn22()
                        fn21(options.RFPTransparency.Value)
                end

                Camera:AddToggle("RealisticFirstPersonT", {
                        Text = "Realistic First Person",
                        Default = false,
                        Callback = function(arg)
                                tbl12.SetRuntimeConnection("RealisticFirstPerson", RunService.RenderStepped, arg, fn22)

                                if arg then
                                        fn22()
                                else
                                        fn21(1)
                                end
                        end,
                })

                Camera:AddSlider("RFPTransparency", {
                        Text = "Limb Transparency",
                        Default = 0.3,
                        Min = 0,
                        Max = 1,
                        Rounding = 2,
                        Callback = function()
                                if toggles.RealisticFirstPersonT.Value then
                                        fn22()
                                end
                        end,

        do
                local Graphics = tbl15.Visual:AddRightGroupbox("Graphics", "file-image")
                local n36 = 0
                local n37 = 0.004
                local n38 = 128

                local function fn21(arg)
                        if os.clock() - arg < n37 then
                                return arg
                        end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                        return os.clock()
                end

                local function fn22(arg)
                        local now2 = os.clock()

                        for i = #tbl7.WaterParts, 1, -1 do
                                if arg ~= n36 then
                                        return false
                                end
                                local v20 = tbl7.WaterParts[i]
                                local v21 = v20[1]
                                local transparency = v20[2]

                                if v21 and v21.Parent then
                                        local value = toggles.WaterWalk and toggles.WaterWalk.Value

                                        if value and transparency ~= 1 then
                                                transparency = 0.5
                                        end

                                        v21.Transparency = transparency

                                        if not value and tbl7.WaterPartStates[v21] then
                                                v21.CanCollide = tbl7.WaterPartStates[v21][1]
                                                tbl7.WaterPartStates[v21] = nil
                                        end
                                end

                                tbl7.WaterParts[i] = nil
                                now2 = fn21(now2)
                        end

                        for i = #tbl7.WaterRegions, 1, -1 do
                                if arg ~= n36 then
                                        return false
                                end
                                terrain:FillRegion(tbl7.WaterRegions[i], 4, Enum.Material.Air)
                                tbl7.WaterRegions[i] = nil
                                now2 = fn21(now2)
                        end

                        table.clear(tbl7.WaterRegions)
                        table.clear(tbl7.WaterParts)
                        return true
                end

                local function fn23(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
                        local v20 = Region3.new(arg, arg2):ExpandToGrid(4)
                        local n39 = v20.CFrame.Position - v20.Size / 2
                        local n40 = v20.CFrame.Position + v20.Size / 2
                        local x = n39.X

                        while x < n40.X do
                                local n41 = math.min(x + n38, n40.X)
                                local y = n39.Y
                                local exitTo = nil

                                while true do
                                        if not (y < n40.Y) then
                                                exitTo = 1
                                                break
                                        else
                                                local n42 = math.min(y + n38, n40.Y)
                                                local z = n39.Z
                                                local exitTo2 = nil

                                                while true do
                                                        if not (z < n40.Z) then
                                                                exitTo2 = 1
                                                                break
                                                        else
                                                                if arg3 == n36 then
                                                                        local n43 = math.min(z + n38, n40.Z)
                                                                        local v21 = Region3.new(Vector3.new(x, y, z), Vector3.new(n41, n42, n43))
                                                                        tbl7.WaterRegions[#tbl7.WaterRegions + 1] = v21
                                                                        terrain:FillRegion(v21, 4, Enum.Material.Water)
                                                                        arg4 = fn21(arg4)
                                                                        z = n43
                                                                        continue
                                                                end

                                                                break
                                                        end
                                                end

                                                if exitTo2 == 1 then
                                                        y = n42
                                                        continue
                                                end
                                                break
                                        end
                                end

                                if exitTo == 1 then
                                        x = n41
                                        continue
                                end
                                return arg4, false
                        end

                        return arg4, true
                end

                local function fn24(arg)
                        n36 += 1
                        local v20 = n36

                        task.spawn(function()
                                if not fn22(v20) or not arg then
                                        return
                                end
                                local objectModel = workspace.Map.AlwaysHereTweenedObjects.Ocean.Object.ObjectModel
                                local vector = Vector3.new(0, tbl9.WaterYOffset, 0)
                                local tbl16 = {}

                                for _, v21 in ipairs(objectModel:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
                                        local tbl17 = tbl7.WaterPartStates[v21]

                                        if not tbl17 then
                                                if v21.Transparency == 1 then
                                                        continue
                                                end
                                                tbl17 = { v21.CanCollide, v21.Transparency }
                                                tbl7.WaterPartStates[v21] = tbl17
                                        end

                                        if tbl17[2] ~= 1 then
                                                tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = { v21, tbl17[2], v21.Position - v21.Size / 2 + vector, v21.Position + v21.Size / 2 + vector }
                                        end
                                end

                                for _, v21 in ipairs(tbl16) do
                                        local v22 = v21[1]

                                        if v22.Parent then
                                                tbl7.WaterParts[#tbl7.WaterParts + 1] = { v22, v21[2] }
                                                v22.Transparency = 1
                                        end
                                end

                                local now2 = os.clock()

                                for _, v21 in ipairs(tbl16) do
                                        if v20 ~= n36 then
                                                return
                                        end
                                        local v22, v23 = fn23(v21[3], v21[4], v20, now2)
                                        if not v23 then
                                                return
                                        end
                                        now2 = v22
                                end
                        end)
                end

                        ['White hole'] = { Id = 'rbxassetid://16292207152', Scale = 1, Type = 'model' },
                        ['Red black hole'] = { Id = 'rbxassetid://12402621316', Scale = 1, Type = 'model' },
                        ['Void black hole'] = { Id = 'rbxassetid://18508680945', Scale = 15, Type = 'model' },
                        ['void black hole 2'] = { Id = 'rbxassetid://15392628947', Scale = 1, Type = 'model' },
                        ['Firework'] = { Id = '', Scale = 1, Type = 'firework' },
                    },
                }

                local customBlackholeOriginalStates = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

                local function customBlackholeWipeOriginal(cbhBh)
                    if not cbhBh then return end
                    local cbhOriginals = {}
                    customBlackholeOriginalStates[cbhBh] = cbhOriginals
                    local cbhDescendants = cbhBh:GetDescendants()
                    if cbhBh:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(cbhDescendants, cbhBh) end

                    for _, cbhDesc in ipairs(cbhDescendants) do
                        if cbhDesc:IsA('BasePart') or cbhDesc:IsA('MeshPart') or cbhDesc:IsA('UnionOperation') then
                            cbhOriginals[cbhDesc] = { Transparency = cbhDesc.Transparency, CastShadow = cbhDesc.CastShadow }
                            cbhDesc.Transparency = 1
                            cbhDesc.CastShadow = false
                        elseif cbhDesc:IsA('ParticleEmitter') or cbhDesc:IsA('Trail') or cbhDesc:IsA('Beam') or cbhDesc:IsA('Smoke') or cbhDesc:IsA('Fire') or cbhDesc:IsA('Sparkles') then
                            cbhOriginals[cbhDesc] = { Enabled = cbhDesc.Enabled }
                            cbhDesc.Enabled = false
                        elseif cbhDesc:IsA('PointLight') or cbhDesc:IsA('SpotLight') or cbhDesc:IsA('SurfaceLight') then
                            cbhOriginals[cbhDesc] = { Enabled = cbhDesc.Enabled }
                            cbhDesc.Enabled = false
                        elseif cbhDesc:IsA('Decal') or cbhDesc:IsA('Texture') then
                            cbhOriginals[cbhDesc] = { Transparency = cbhDesc.Transparency }
                            cbhDesc.Transparency = 1
                        elseif cbhDesc:IsA('BillboardGui') or cbhDesc:IsA('SurfaceGui') then
                            cbhOriginals[cbhDesc] = { Enabled = cbhDesc.Enabled }
                            cbhDesc.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end

                    if cbhBh:IsA('BasePart') then
                        cbhBh.Transparency = 1
                    end
                    if cbhBh:IsA('Model') and cbhBh.PrimaryPart then
                        cbhBh.PrimaryPart.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end

                local function customBlackholeRestoreOriginal(cbhBh)
                    if not cbhBh then return end
                    for cbhDesc, cbhProperties in pairs(customBlackholeOriginalStates[cbhBh] or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            for cbhProperty, cbhValue in pairs(cbhProperties) do
                                cbhDesc[cbhProperty] = cbhValue
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    customBlackholeOriginalStates[cbhBh] = nil
                end

                local function customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                    if not cbhBh then return end
                    local cbhData = customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh]
                    if not cbhData then return end
                    if cbhData.Anim then
                        pcall(function() cbhData.Anim:Disconnect() end)
                    end
                    if cbhData.Ancestry then
                        pcall(function() cbhData.Ancestry:Disconnect() end)
                    end
                    if cbhData.Model then
                        pcall(function() cbhData.Model:Destroy() end)
                    end
                    customBlackholeRestoreOriginal(cbhBh)
                    customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] = nil
                end

                local function customBlackholeBuildFirework(cbhBh, cbhData)
                    local cbhHole = cbhData.Hole
                    customBlackholeWipeOriginal(cbhBh)
                    local cbhModel = Instance.new("Model")
                    cbhModel.Name = "FireworkEffect"
                    cbhModel.Parent = cbhBh
                    cbhData.Model = cbhModel
                    local cbhRandom = Random.new()
                    local cbhSparks = {}
                    local cbhLifetime = 1.5
                    local cbhBurstTime = 0
                    local cbhNextBurst = 1.65
                    local cbhGravity = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity * 0.45, 0)
                    local cbhCastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                    cbhCastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    cbhCastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { cbhBh }
                    cbhCastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
                    cbhCastParams.IgnoreWater = false
                    local cbhTrailWidth = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.65),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                    })
                    local cbhTrailTransparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                    })
                    local function cbhAddGlow(cbhPart, cbhSize)
                        local cbhBillboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        cbhBillboard.Name = "Glow"
                        cbhBillboard.Adornee = cbhPart
                        cbhBillboard.Size = UDim2.fromScale(cbhSize, cbhSize)
                        cbhBillboard.LightInfluence = 0
                        cbhBillboard.AlwaysOnTop = false
                        cbhBillboard.MaxDistance = 300
                        cbhBillboard.Parent = cbhPart
                        local cbhImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                        cbhImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        cbhImage.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                        cbhImage.Image = "rbxasset://textures/particles/flare_main.dds"
                        cbhImage.ImageTransparency = 0.7
                        cbhImage.Parent = cbhBillboard
                        return cbhBillboard, cbhImage
                    end
                    local cbhSource = Instance.new("Part")
                    cbhSource.Name = "BurstOrigin"
                    cbhSource.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
                    cbhSource.Anchored = true
                    cbhSource.CanCollide = false
                    cbhSource.CanTouch = false
                    cbhSource.CanQuery = false
                    cbhSource.CastShadow = false
                    cbhSource.Transparency = 1
                    cbhSource.Position = cbhHole.Position
                    cbhSource.Parent = cbhModel
                    local cbhSourceGlow, cbhSourceImage = cbhAddGlow(cbhSource, 5)
                    local cbhFlash = Instance.new("PointLight")
                    cbhFlash.Range = 14
                    cbhFlash.Brightness = 0
                    cbhFlash.Shadows = false
                    cbhFlash.Parent = cbhSource
                    for cbhIndex = 1, 56 do
                        local cbhSize = cbhRandom:NextNumber(0.08, 0.15)
                        local cbhPart = Instance.new("Part")
                        cbhPart.Name = "Spark"
                        cbhPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                        cbhPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        cbhPart.Size = Vector3.new(cbhSize, cbhSize, cbhSize)
                        cbhPart.Anchored = true
                        cbhPart.CanCollide = false
                        cbhPart.CanTouch = false
                        cbhPart.CanQuery = false
                        cbhPart.CastShadow = false
                        cbhPart.Transparency = 1
                        cbhPart.Position = cbhHole.Position
                        cbhPart.Parent = cbhModel
                        local cbhFirst = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        cbhFirst.Position = Vector3.new(-cbhSize * 0.4, 0, 0)
                        cbhFirst.Parent = cbhPart
                        local cbhSecond = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        cbhSecond.Position = Vector3.new(cbhSize * 0.4, 0, 0)
                        cbhSecond.Parent = cbhPart
                        local cbhTrail = Instance.new("Trail")
                        cbhTrail.Attachment0 = cbhFirst
                        cbhTrail.Attachment1 = cbhSecond
                        cbhTrail.FaceCamera = true
                        cbhTrail.Lifetime = 0.12
                        cbhTrail.MaxLength = 2.4
                        cbhTrail.MinLength = 0.01
                        cbhTrail.LightEmission = 1
                        cbhTrail.LightInfluence = 0
                        cbhTrail.Brightness = 3
                        cbhTrail.WidthScale = cbhTrailWidth
                        cbhTrail.Transparency = cbhTrailTransparency
                        cbhTrail.Enabled = false
                        cbhTrail.Parent = cbhPart
                        local cbhBillboardG, cbhGlow = cbhAddGlow(cbhPart, cbhSize * 6)
                        cbhBillboardG.Enabled = false
                        cbhSparks[cbhIndex] = {
                            Part = cbhPart, Trail = cbhTrail, Billboard = cbhBillboardG, Glow = cbhGlow,
                            Size = cbhSize, Radius = cbhSize * 0.5, Active = false,
                            Position = cbhHole.Position, Velocity = Vector3.zero,
                        }
                    end
                    local function cbhEmitBurst()
                        cbhBurstTime = cbhData.Time
                        local cbhPalette = { 0.1, 0.56, 0.76, 0.94 }
                        local cbhHue = cbhPalette[cbhRandom:NextInteger(1, #cbhPalette)]
                        local cbhColor = Color3.fromHSV(cbhHue, 0.7, 1)
                        cbhFlash.Color = cbhColor
                        cbhSourceImage.ImageColor3 = cbhColor
                        for cbhIndex, cbhSpark in ipairs(cbhSparks) do
                            local cbhVertical = 1 - 2 * (cbhIndex - 0.5) / #cbhSparks
                            local cbhRadial = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - cbhVertical * cbhVertical))
                            local cbhAngle = cbhIndex * 2.399963229728653 + cbhRandom:NextNumber(-0.08, 0.08)
                            local cbhDirection = Vector3.new(math.cos(cbhAngle) * cbhRadial, cbhVertical, math.sin(cbhAngle) * cbhRadial)
                            local cbhSparkColor = Color3.fromHSV((cbhHue + cbhRandom:NextNumber(-0.025, 0.025)) % 1,
                                cbhRandom:NextNumber(0.45, 0.8), 1)
                            cbhSpark.Active = true
                            cbhSpark.Position = cbhHole.Position + cbhDirection * 0.3
                            cbhSpark.Velocity = cbhDirection * cbhRandom:NextNumber(24, 38) + Vector3.new(0, 36, 0)
                            cbhSpark.Part.Position = cbhSpark.Position
                            cbhSpark.Part.Size = Vector3.new(cbhSpark.Size, cbhSpark.Size, cbhSpark.Size)
                            cbhSpark.Part.Color = cbhSparkColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4)
                            cbhSpark.Part.Transparency = 0.05
                            cbhSpark.Glow.ImageColor3 = cbhSparkColor
                            cbhSpark.Glow.ImageTransparency = 0.7
                            cbhSpark.Billboard.Enabled = true
                            cbhSpark.Trail:Clear()
                            cbhSpark.Trail.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, cbhSpark.Part.Color),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, cbhSparkColor),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, cbhSparkColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0.12, 0.03, 0.02), 0.5)),
                            })
                            cbhSpark.Trail.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end
                    cbhEmitBurst()
                    cbhData.Anim = cbhRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(cbhDt)
                        if not customBlackholeState.Enabled or not cbhBh.Parent
                            or not cbhHole.Parent or not cbhModel.Parent then
                            customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                            return
                        end
                        local cbhElapsed = math.max(tonumber(cbhDt) or 0, 0)
                        cbhData.Time += cbhElapsed
                        if cbhData.Time >= cbhNextBurst then
                            cbhEmitBurst()
                            cbhNextBurst = cbhData.Time + 1.65
                        end
                        cbhSource.Position = cbhHole.Position
                        local cbhAge = cbhData.Time - cbhBurstTime
                        local cbhPulse = math.exp(-cbhAge * 18)
                        cbhFlash.Brightness = cbhPulse * 7
                        cbhSourceImage.ImageTransparency = 1 - cbhPulse * 0.6
                        cbhSourceGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(3 + cbhPulse * 3, 3 + cbhPulse * 3)
                        local cbhStep = math.min(cbhElapsed, 0.1)
                        for _, cbhSpark in ipairs(cbhSparks) do
                            if not cbhSpark.Active then continue end
                            if cbhAge >= cbhLifetime then
                                cbhSpark.Active = false
                                cbhSpark.Part.Transparency = 1
                                cbhSpark.Billboard.Enabled = false
                                cbhSpark.Trail.Enabled = false
                                cbhSpark.Trail:Clear()
                                continue
                            end
                            local cbhOldVelocity = cbhSpark.Velocity
                            local cbhVelocity = (cbhOldVelocity + cbhGravity * cbhStep) * math.exp(-0.65 * cbhStep)
                            local cbhMovement = (cbhOldVelocity + cbhVelocity) * (cbhStep * 0.5)
                            local cbhPosition = cbhSpark.Position
                            local cbhRemaining = cbhStep
                            for _ = 1, 3 do
                                local cbhLength = cbhMovement.Magnitude
                                if cbhLength < 0.00001 then break end
                                local cbhHit = workspace:Spherecast(cbhPosition, cbhSpark.Radius, cbhMovement, cbhCastParams)
                                if not cbhHit then
                                    cbhPosition += cbhMovement
                                    break
                                end
                                local cbhTraveled = math.clamp(cbhHit.Distance, 0, cbhLength)
                                cbhPosition += cbhMovement.Unit * math.max(cbhTraveled - 0.002, 0) + cbhHit.Normal * 0.012
                                local cbhSurfaceVelocity = cbhHit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and cbhHit.Instance.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
                                local cbhRelativeVelocity = cbhVelocity - cbhSurfaceVelocity
                                local cbhImpactSpeed = cbhRelativeVelocity:Dot(cbhHit.Normal)
                                if cbhImpactSpeed < 0 then
                                    local cbhTangent = cbhRelativeVelocity - cbhHit.Normal * cbhImpactSpeed
                                    cbhVelocity = cbhTangent * 0.86 - cbhHit.Normal * cbhImpactSpeed * 0.58 + cbhSurfaceVelocity
                                end
                                cbhRemaining *= 1 - cbhTraveled / cbhLength
                                cbhMovement = cbhVelocity * cbhRemaining
                            end
                            cbhSpark.Position = cbhPosition
                            cbhSpark.Velocity = cbhVelocity
                            local cbhFade = math.clamp((cbhAge - 1.05) / 0.45, 0, 1)
                            local cbhShimmer = 0.025 * (1 + math.sin(cbhAge * 38 + cbhSpark.Size * 100))
                            local cbhSize = cbhSpark.Size * (1 - cbhFade * 0.45)
                            cbhSpark.Part.Size = Vector3.new(cbhSize, cbhSize, cbhSize)
                            cbhSpark.Part.Position = cbhPosition
                            cbhSpark.Part.Transparency = math.clamp(0.05 + cbhFade * 0.95 + cbhShimmer, 0, 1)
                            cbhSpark.Glow.ImageTransparency = 0.7 + cbhFade * 0.3
                            cbhSpark.Trail.Enabled = cbhAge < cbhLifetime - cbhSpark.Trail.Lifetime
                        end
                    end)
                    cbhData.Ancestry = cbhBh.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                        if not cbhBh.Parent then customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh) end
                    end)
                end

                local function customBlackholeBuild(cbhBh)
                    if not customBlackholeState.Enabled or not cbhBh or not cbhBh.Parent then return end
                    if customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] then return end

                    local cbhHole = cbhBh:FindFirstChild('Hole') or cbhBh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart')
                    if not cbhHole then return end

                    local cbhPositionValue = cbhHole.Position
                    local cbhOption = customBlackholeState.Options[customBlackholeState.Selected] or customBlackholeState.Options['Space Blackhole']

                    local cbhData = {
                        Time = 0,
                        Hole = cbhHole,
                        Anim = nil,
                        Model = nil,
                        SpinSpeed = 0,
                        TargetSpin = 0.8,
                        Scale = 0.01,
                        TargetScale = cbhOption.Scale * customBlackholeState.Scale,
                        StartTime = tick(),
                    }
                    customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] = cbhData

                    if cbhOption.Type == 'firework' then
                        customBlackholeBuildFirework(cbhBh, cbhData)
                        return
                    end

                    local cbhAssetId = cbhOption.Id
                    local cbhModel = nil

                    local cbhSuccess, cbhResult = pcall(function()
                        return game:GetObjects(cbhAssetId)[1]
                    end)

                    if cbhSuccess and cbhResult then
                        cbhModel = cbhResult
                    end

                    if not cbhModel then
                        local cbhCleanId = tonumber((cbhAssetId:gsub('rbxassetid://', '')))
                        if cbhCleanId then
                            cbhSuccess, cbhResult = pcall(function()
                                return cbhInsertService:LoadAsset(cbhCleanId)
                            end)

                            if cbhSuccess and cbhResult then
                                cbhModel = cbhResult:GetChildren()[1]
                                if cbhModel then cbhModel.Parent = nil end
                                cbhResult:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] ~= cbhData or not customBlackholeState.Enabled or not cbhBh.Parent then
                        if cbhModel then cbhModel:Destroy() end
                        if customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] == cbhData then customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh) end
                        return
                    end

                    if not cbhModel then
                        customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                        return
                    end

                    customBlackholeWipeOriginal(cbhBh)

                    cbhModel.Parent = cbhBh
                    cbhModel.Name = 'CosmicMesh'

                    for _, cbhDesc in ipairs(cbhModel:GetDescendants()) do
                        if cbhDesc:IsA('AnimationController') or cbhDesc:IsA('Animator') or cbhDesc:IsA('Animation') then
                            cbhDesc:Destroy()
                        end
                    end

                    if cbhModel:IsA('Model') then
                        for _, cbhPart in ipairs(cbhModel:GetDescendants()) do
                            if cbhPart:IsA('BasePart') or cbhPart:IsA('MeshPart') then
                                cbhPart.Anchored = true
                                cbhPart.CanCollide = false
                                cbhPart.CastShadow = false
                            end
                        end

                        cbhData.InitialRotation = cbhModel:GetPivot().Rotation
                        cbhModel:ScaleTo(cbhData.Scale)
                        cbhModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cbhPositionValue) * cbhData.InitialRotation)

                        cbhData.Model = cbhModel
                        cbhData.Anim = cbhRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(cbhDeltaTime)
                            if not cbhBh.Parent or not cbhHole.Parent or not cbhModel.Parent then
                                customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                                return
                            end

                            local cbhCurrentPos = cbhHole.Position
                            local cbhAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-5 * math.max(tonumber(cbhDeltaTime) or 0, 0))
                            cbhData.TargetScale = (customBlackholeState.Options[customBlackholeState.Selected] and customBlackholeState.Options[customBlackholeState.Selected].Scale or 1) * customBlackholeState.Scale
                            cbhData.SpinSpeed += (cbhData.TargetSpin - cbhData.SpinSpeed) * cbhAlpha
                            cbhData.Scale += (cbhData.TargetScale - cbhData.Scale) * cbhAlpha
                            cbhData.Time = cbhData.Time + cbhDeltaTime * cbhData.SpinSpeed
                            cbhModel:ScaleTo(cbhData.Scale)
                            cbhModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cbhCurrentPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, cbhData.Time, 0) * cbhData.InitialRotation)
                        end)
                    elseif cbhModel:IsA('BasePart') then
                        cbhData.BaseSize = cbhModel.Size
                        cbhData.InitialRotation = cbhModel.CFrame.Rotation
                        cbhModel.Anchored = true
                        cbhModel.CanCollide = false
                        cbhModel.CastShadow = false
                        cbhModel.Size = cbhModel.Size * 0.01
                        cbhModel.CFrame = CFrame.new(cbhPositionValue)
                        cbhData.Model = cbhModel
                        cbhData.Anim = cbhRunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(cbhDeltaTime)
                            if not cbhBh.Parent or not cbhHole.Parent or not cbhModel.Parent then
                                customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                                return
                            end

                            local cbhCurrentPos = cbhHole.Position
                            local cbhAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-5 * math.max(tonumber(cbhDeltaTime) or 0, 0))
                            cbhData.TargetScale = (customBlackholeState.Options[customBlackholeState.Selected] and customBlackholeState.Options[customBlackholeState.Selected].Scale or 1) * customBlackholeState.Scale
                            cbhData.SpinSpeed += (cbhData.TargetSpin - cbhData.SpinSpeed) * cbhAlpha
                            cbhData.Scale += (cbhData.TargetScale - cbhData.Scale) * cbhAlpha
                            cbhData.Time = cbhData.Time + cbhDeltaTime * cbhData.SpinSpeed

                            if cbhData.Model then
                                cbhData.Model.CFrame = CFrame.new(cbhCurrentPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, cbhData.Time, 0) * cbhData.InitialRotation
                                cbhData.Model.Size = cbhData.BaseSize * cbhData.Scale
                            end
                        end)
                    else
                        cbhModel:Destroy()
                        customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                        return
                    end

                    cbhData.Ancestry = cbhBh.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                        if not cbhBh.Parent then
                            customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                        end
                    end)

                    customBlackholeState.Active[cbhBh] = cbhData
                end

                local function customBlackholeRefreshBlackholes()
                    for cbhBh in pairs(customBlackholeState.Active) do
                        customBlackholeCleanup(cbhBh)
                    end
                    if customBlackholeState.Enabled then
                        for _, cbhInstance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                            if cbhInstance.Name:lower():find('blackhole') or cbhInstance.Name == "BlackHoleKick" then
                                customBlackholeBuild(cbhInstance)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local function customBlackholeStartSystem()
                    if customBlackholeState.Connection then return end
                    customBlackholeState.Connection = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(cbhInstance)
                        if not customBlackholeState.Enabled then return end
                        if cbhInstance.Name:lower():find('blackhole') or cbhInstance.Name == "BlackHoleKick" then
                            task.wait(0.2)
                            if customBlackholeState.Enabled then customBlackholeBuild(cbhInstance) end
                        end
                    end)
                end

                local function customBlackholeStopSystem()
                    if customBlackholeState.Connection then
                        customBlackholeState.Connection:Disconnect()
                        customBlackholeState.Connection = nil
                    end
                    customBlackholeRefreshBlackholes()
                end

                v23:AddDivider("Custom Blackhole Models")

                v23:AddToggle('EnableCustomBlackhole', {
                    Text = 'Toggle Custom Blackhole',
                    Default = false,
                    Tooltip = 'Replaces default blackholes with the selected 3D model. Default model: Space Blackhole',
                    Callback = function(cbhValue)
                        customBlackholeState.Enabled = cbhValue
                        if cbhValue then
                            customBlackholeStartSystem()
                            customBlackholeRefreshBlackholes()
                        else
                            customBlackholeStopSystem()
                        end
                    end,
                })

                v23:AddDropdown('SelectBlackholeModel', {
                    Values = {
                        'Space Blackhole',
                        'Clean Blackhole',
                        'Hollow purple blackhole',
                        'black hole',
                        'White hole',
                        'Red black hole',
                        'Void black hole',
                        'void black hole 2',
                        'Firework',
                    },
                    Default = 'Space Blackhole',
                    Multi = false,
                    Text = 'Selected Model',
                    Tooltip = 'Pick a custom blackhole model. Default is Space Blackhole.',
                    Callback = function(cbhVal)
                        customBlackholeState.Selected = cbhVal
                        if customBlackholeState.Enabled then
                            customBlackholeRefreshBlackholes()
                        end
                    end,
                })

                v23:AddSlider('BlackholeSizeSlider', {
                    Text = 'Blackhole Size',
                    Default = 1,
                    Min = 1,
                    Max = 1000,
                    Rounding = 0,
                    Tooltip = 'Global size multiplier applied to the selected model.',
                    Callback = function(cbhSizeVal)
                        customBlackholeState.Scale = cbhSizeVal
                    end,
                })

                v23:AddDivider("Misc")

                v23:AddLabel("Blackhole Color"):AddColorPicker("BHColorPicker", {
                        Default = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                        Title = "Blackhole Color",
                        Callback = function(customBHColor)
                                tbl9.CustomBHColor = customBHColor

                                for _, v24 in workspace:GetChildren() do
                                        if not (v24.Name ~= "BlackHoleKick" and v24.Name ~= "StayedBH") then
                                                local hole = v24:WaitForChild("Hole", 0.25)

                                                if hole then
                                                        local billboardGui = hole:WaitForChild("BillboardGui", 1.5)

                                                        if billboardGui then
                                                                local large = billboardGui:WaitForChild("Large", 1.5)
                                                                local small = billboardGui:WaitForChild("Small", 1.5)

                                                                if large and large:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                                                                        large.ImageColor3 = customBHColor
                                                                end

                                                                if small and small:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                                                                        small.ImageColor3 = customBHColor
                                                                end
                                                        end
                                                end
                                        end
                                end
                        end,
                })

                v23:AddToggle("EnableBHStaying", {
                        Text = "Toggle Blackhole Staying",
                        Default = false,
                        Tooltip = "Makes blackholes not disappear after spinning, until you turn this off.",
                        Callback = function(blackholeStaying)
                                tbl8.BlackholeStaying = blackholeStaying
                        end,
                })

                local v24 = v20:AddTab(nil, "volume-2")
                local mapNoises = map:FindFirstChild("MapNoises")
                local tbl17 = {}

                local tbl18 = {
                        {
                                "MuteAmbience",
                                "Mute Ambience",
                                function(arg)
                                        return mapNoises and arg:IsDescendantOf(mapNoises)
                                end,
                        },
                        {
                                "MuteBoomboxes",
                                "Mute Boomboxes & Jukeboxes",
                                function(arg)

                                end

                local function fn22(arg)
                        if not arg:IsA("Sound") then
                                return

                        local v25 = fn21(arg)

                        if v25 then
                                if not v26 then
                                        local tbl19 = { arg.Volume }
                                        tbl17[arg] = tbl19

                                        if v25[4] then

                                                        if fn21(arg) and arg.Volume ~= 0 then
                                                                arg.Volume = 0
                                                        end
                                                end)
                                        end
                                end

                                arg.Volume = 0
                        elseif v26 then
                                tbl17[arg] = nil

                                if v26[2] then
                                        v26[2]:Disconnect()
                                end

                                if arg.Parent then
                                        arg.Volume = v26[1]
                                end
                        end
                end

                                local v23, v24 = tbl12.SaveACCustomPresets(str6, tbl17)

                                if not v23 then
                                        tbl7.CustomACPresets[str6] = v21
                                        fn18("Couldn't save custom preset: " .. v24)
                                        return
                                end

                                tbl12.SyncACCustomPresets(str6)
                                options.ACCustomPresetName:SetValue(str6)
                                local v25 = fn18
                                local str7

                                if v21 then
                                        str7 = "Updated custom preset!"
                                else
                                        str7 = "Saved custom preset!"
                                end

                                v25(str7)
                        end,
                })

                        Text = "Load Custom Preset",
                        Disabled = flag12,
                        DisabledTooltip = "Your exploit is missing readfile/writefile support.",
                        Func = function()

        tbl12.GetTarget = function()
                if not lib.IsMobile and mouse then
                        return mouse.Target
                end
                local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
                local v20 = currentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local v21 = tbl12.Char()

                if v21 then
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v21 }
                end

                local hit = workspace:Raycast(v20.Origin, v20.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
                return hit and hit.Instance
        end

        tbl12.GetHit = function()
                if not lib.IsMobile and mouse then
                        return mouse.Hit
                end
                local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
                local v20 = currentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local v21 = tbl12.Char()

                if v21 then
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v21 }
                end

                local hit = workspace:Raycast(v20.Origin, v20.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
                local cframe

                if hit then
                        cframe = CFrame.new(hit.Position)
                else
                        cframe = CFrame.new(v20.Origin + v20.Direction * 1000)
                end

                return cframe
        end

        do
                local Whitelist = tbl15.Lists:AddLeftGroupbox("Whitelist", "shield-check")
                local v20 = tbl12.CreatePlayerDropdown(Whitelist, "Whitelist", tbl7.Whitelisted)

                v20:OnChanged(function()
                        if tbl8.SilentAim then
                                tbl12.RefreshSilentAim()
                        end
                end)

                local tbl16 = {}
                local friendStatusChanged = nil

                pcall(function()
                        friendStatusChanged = localPlayer.FriendStatusChanged
                end)

                local function fn21(arg, arg2)
                        if flag11 or not tbl8.AutoWhitelistFriends or arg == localPlayer or arg.Parent ~= Players or tbl12.IsProtectedPlayer(arg) then
                                return
                        end
                        local flag12 = v20.Value[arg] == true

                        if arg2 then
                                if flag12 then
                                        return
                                end
                                tbl16[arg.UserId] = true
                        else
                                if not tbl16[arg.UserId] then
                                        return
                                end
                                tbl16[arg.UserId] = nil
                                if not flag12 then
                                        return
                                end
                        end

                        local tbl17 = {}

                        for k, v21 in v20.Value, nil, nil do
                                if k ~= arg then
                                        tbl17[k] = v21
                                end
                        end

                        if arg2 then
                                tbl17[arg] = true
                        end

                        v20:SetValue(tbl17)
                end

                local function fn22(arg)
                        if arg == localPlayer or arg.Parent ~= Players or not tbl8.AutoWhitelistFriends then
                                return
                        end
                        local ok, result = pcall(localPlayer.IsFriendsWith, localPlayer, arg.UserId)

                        if ok then
                                fn21(arg, result)
                        end
                end

                Whitelist:AddDivider("Settings")

                Whitelist:AddToggle("AutoWhitelistFriends", {
                        Text = "Auto Whitelist Friends",

                                if tbl8.AutoWhitelistFriends == autoWhitelistFriends then
                                        return
                                end
                                tbl8.AutoWhitelistFriends = autoWhitelistFriends
                                tbl12.SetRuntimeConnection("AutoWhitelistFriends", Players.PlayerAdded, autoWhitelistFriends, fn22)

                                if friendStatusChanged then
                                        pcall(tbl12.SetRuntimeConnection, "AutoWhitelistStatus", friendStatusChanged, autoWhitelistFriends, function(arg, arg2)
                                                if arg2 == Enum.FriendStatus.Friend or arg2 == Enum.FriendStatus.NotFriend then
                                                        fn21(arg, arg2 == Enum.FriendStatus.Friend)
                                                end
                                        end)
                                end

                                if not autoWhitelistFriends then
                                        return
                                end

                                task.spawn(function()
                                        for _, v21 in Players:GetPlayers() do
                                                if flag11 or not tbl8.AutoWhitelistFriends then
                                                        return
                                                end
                                                fn22(v21)
                                        end
                                end)
                        end,
                })

                                        tbl12.RefreshSilentAim()

        do
                local function fn21(arg)
                        if typeof(arg) ~= "UDim2" then
                                return
                        end
                        return { arg.X.Scale, arg.X.Offset, arg.Y.Scale, arg.Y.Offset }
                end

                local function fn22(arg)
                        if typeof(arg) ~= "table" then
                                return
                        end

                        for i = 1, 4 do
                                if typeof(arg[i]) ~= "number" then
                                        return
                                end
                        end

                        return UDim2.new(arg[1], arg[2], arg[3], arg[4])
                end

                local function fn23(arg)
                        local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
                        local n36 = arg.AbsolutePosition + arg.AbsoluteSize / 2
                        local tbl16 = {}
                        local n37 = n36.X / math.max(viewportSize.X, 1)
                        local n38 = n36.Y / math.max(viewportSize.Y, 1)
                        tbl16[1] = n37
                        tbl16[2] = n38
                        return tbl16
                end

                local function fn24(arg, arg2, position)
                        if not arg or not arg.Parent then
                                return
                        end

                        if position then
                                arg.Position = position
                        end

                        local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
                        local absoluteSize = arg.AbsoluteSize
                        local x = arg.AbsolutePosition.X
                        local y = arg.AbsolutePosition.Y

                        if typeof(arg2) == "table" and typeof(arg2[1]) == "number" and typeof(arg2[2]) == "number" then
                                x = arg2[1] * viewportSize.X - absoluteSize.X / 2
                                y = arg2[2] * viewportSize.Y - absoluteSize.Y / 2
                        end

                        local n36 = math.clamp(x, 6, math.max(6, viewportSize.X - absoluteSize.X - 6))
                        local n37 = math.clamp(y, 6, math.max(6, viewportSize.Y - absoluteSize.Y - 6))
                        local absolutePosition

                        if arg.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                absolutePosition = arg.Parent.AbsolutePosition
                        else
                                absolutePosition = Vector2.zero
                        end

                        arg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round(n36 - absolutePosition.X + arg.AnchorPoint.X * absoluteSize.X), math.round(n37 - absolutePosition.Y + arg.AnchorPoint.Y * absoluteSize.Y))
                end

                local function fn25(arg, arg2)
                        if not arg or not arg.Parent or not arg2 then
                                return
                        end
                        local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
                        local absoluteSize

                        if arg.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                absoluteSize = arg.Parent.AbsoluteSize
                        else
                                absoluteSize = viewportSize
                        end

                        local uiScale = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                        uiScale = uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1
                        local n36 = (absoluteSize.Y * arg2.Y.Scale + arg2.Y.Offset) * uiScale
                        local n37 = math.min(1, (viewportSize.X - 12) / math.max((absoluteSize.X * arg2.X.Scale + arg2.X.Offset) * uiScale, 1), (viewportSize.Y - 12) / math.max(n36, 1))
                        local n38 = arg2.Y.Scale * n37
                        local round = math.round
                        local n39 = arg2.Y.Offset * n37
                        arg.Size = UDim2.new(arg2.X.Scale * n37, math.round(arg2.X.Offset * n37), n38, round(n39))
                end

                        local mainFrame = v19.MainFrame

                        local tbl16 = {

                                n36 = arg.SidebarWidth

        task.spawn(function()
                for _, v20 in lib.Tabs, nil, nil do
                        for _, v21 in v20.Groupboxes, nil, nil do
                                v21:Resize()
                        end
                end
        end)

        do
                local tbl16 = {}

                Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
                        if flag11 then
                                return
                        end

                        if tbl9.SelectedACPoseCenter == player then
                                tbl9.SelectedACPoseCenter = nil
                        end

                        local tbl17 = {}
                        local flag12 = tbl7.SelectedPlayersAC[player] == true

                        for _, playerDropdown in ipairs(tbl7.PlayerDropdowns) do
                                if playerDropdown.Selected[player] then
                                        playerDropdown.Selected[player] = nil
                                        playerDropdown.Values[player] = nil
                                        table.insert(tbl17, playerDropdown)
                                end
                        end

                        if flag12 and tbl12.SyncACPoseTargets then
                                task.defer(tbl12.SyncACPoseTargets)
                        end

                        if #tbl17 == 0 then
                                return
                        end
                        tbl12.NotifyEvent("Player Left", { leftPlayer = tbl12.FormatPlayer(player), listCount = #tbl17 }, "Player Left")
                        tbl16[player.UserId] = tbl17
                end)

                Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
                        local v20 = tbl16[player.UserId]
                        if not v20 or flag11 or not getgenv().OwnerSigmaHubRunning then
                                return
                        end
                        tbl16[player.UserId] = nil

                        for _, v21 in ipairs(v20) do
                                if not table.find(v21.Dropdown.Values, player) then
                                        v21.Dropdown:AddValues({ player })
                                end

                                if v21.Multi == false then
                                        v21.Dropdown:SetValue(player)
                                        table.clear(v21.Values)
                                        v21.Values[player] = true
                                        table.clear(v21.Selected)
                                        v21.Selected[player] = true
                                else
                                        local tbl17 = {}

                                        for k, v22 in pairs(v21.Selected) do
                                                tbl17[k] = v22
                                        end

                                        tbl17[player] = true
                                        v21.Dropdown:SetValue(tbl17)
                                        table.clear(v21.Values)

                                        for k, v22 in pairs(tbl17) do
                                                v21.Values[k] = v22
                                        end

                                        v21.Selected[player] = true
                                end
                        end

                        tbl12.NotifyEvent("Player Rejoined", { rejoinedPlayer = tbl12.FormatPlayer(player), listCount = #v20 }, "Player Rejoined")
                end)
        end

        fn18("Script loaded in " .. math.round((tick() - getgenv().LoadTime) * 100) / 100 .. " seconds", "Owner sigma hub", 71450094482101)
        getgenv().LoadTime = nil

        return {
                copyright = "Owner sigma hub",
        }
end

]====]
sources['Bootstrap'] = [====[
local sources = ...
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.OwnerSigmaHubRunning or env.OwnerSigmaHubStarting then
    warn("Owner Sigma Hub is already running or starting")
    return
end
assert(type(loadstring) == "function", "This executor does not support loadstring")
assert(type(getgenv) == "function", "This executor does not support getgenv")
env.OwnerSigmaHubStarting = true
local cleanup
local function registerCleanup(fn) cleanup = fn end
local cache = {}
local loading = {}
local function requireModule(name)
    if cache[name] then return cache[name] end
    assert(not loading[name], "Circular module dependency: " .. tostring(name))
    assert(type(sources[name]) == "string", "Missing module: " .. tostring(name))
    loading[name] = true
    local chunk, message = loadstring(sources[name], "@OwnerSigmaHub/" .. name)
    assert(chunk, message)
    local ok, result = pcall(chunk, requireModule)
    loading[name] = nil
    assert(ok, result)
    assert(type(result) == "table", "Invalid module: " .. name)
    cache[name] = result
    return result
end
local reloadPath
local ok, result = xpcall(function()
    if type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
        local success = pcall(function()
            local lines = {"local sources = {}"}
            for _, name in ipairs({"Library", "ThemeManager", "SaveManager", "TheWorstUI", "Icons", "Main", "Bootstrap"}) do
                lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("sources[%q] = %q", name, sources[name])
            end
            lines[#lines + 1] = 'local run, message = loadstring(sources.Bootstrap, "@OwnerSigmaHub/Bootstrap"); assert(run, message); return run(sources)'
            writefile("OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua", table.concat(lines, "\n"))
            assert(type(readfile("OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua")) == "string")
        end)
        if success then reloadPath = "OwnerSigmaHubRestored.lua" end
    end
    local chunk, message = loadstring(sources.Main, "@OwnerSigmaHub/Main")
    assert(chunk, message)
    return chunk(requireModule, reloadPath, registerCleanup)
end, function(message)
    if debug and debug.traceback then return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end
    return tostring(message)
end)
env.OwnerSigmaHubStarting = false
if not ok then
    if cleanup then pcall(cleanup) end
    env.OwnerSigmaHubRunning = false
    warn("Owner Sigma Hub initialization failed: " .. tostring(result))
    return nil, result
end
return result

]====]
